I replied to Marcus in his #north-random thread. I told him I've noted that the signed order form for Thornbury Cloth Co. is due 19 November, not the date in his #north-team post from this morning.

He said no action was needed, so I didn't change or send anything else. A signing deadline is an operational fact, not a finance figure, so it was fine to confirm it in the channel.
